title: Schema Composer: Walkthrough Storyboard & Validation Microcopy Kit
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact onboarding kit for the Schema Composer feature that includes a 6-panel walkthrough storyboard, validated microcopy for inline validation messages, a photography-style screenshot checklist for marketing/product screenshots, and variants for dark/light themes. Deliverables: Figma file with frames and export-ready assets, a short microcopy style guide (inline/summary/error states), a set of annotated screenshots for docs and release notes, and a small QA checklist for engineers to verify validation behavior. Focus on clarity for first-time users who are setting up structured output schemas for prompts and on reducing error recovery time for common schema mistakes.
comments: 2025-11-19: Kickoff review with PM and Eng. Agreed scope: storyboard + microcopy + screenshot checklist. Action: produce initial frames by 2025-12-03. (link to notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SO/Schema+Composer+Kickoff)

2025-12-04: First draft frames uploaded to Figma. Feedback from PM (Lena Ortiz): simplify panel 3 to remove technical terms; user testing showed confusion around 'required' vs 'recommended'. (Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/Schema-Composer-Onboarding)

2025-12-12: Engineering (Ravi) flagged that validator supports multiple error codes; design will include 3 canonical messages plus 'advanced' expandable details. Added acceptance criteria item for expandable details behavior.

2026-01-09: Internal review with Docs. Agreed to provide 3 screenshot aspect ratios: 16:9 hero, 4:3 doc inline, and 1:1 thumbnail. Docs will reference the 'microcopy snippets' file. (Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1XYZ)
2026-02-05: Usability testing with 8 participants. Key insight: users expect action buttons next to validation hints. Updated storyboard to include inline 'Fix' CTA and tooltip examples.

2026-02-18: Design review done. PM approved asset list pending final accessibility run. Next: final export and handoff to ENG for screenshot verification. GitHub PR for screenshot checklist created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
design_notes: Walkthrough should be skippable and surfaced on first use only. Add a small 'Don't show again' checkbox.
Validation microcopy must be succinct (<80 chars for inline messages) with an optional link to 'Why this matters' expanded text.
Color tokens: use --rw-green-500 for success, --rw-yellow-400 for warning, --rw-red-500 for error. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for inline messages.
Include 3 error severity levels: hint, warning, error. Each has suggested CTA patterns: hint (Learn), warning (Fix suggestions), error (Open schema editor).
Provide localization notes: keep messages without UI-specific verbs when possible to ease translation.
Animated transition preference: fade + slide at 180ms to match Console micro-interactions.
decisions: Use compact 6-panel storyboard rather than a modal deep-dive to reduce cognitive load.
Inline 'Fix' CTAs will open a focused editor pane rather than a full-screen modal to preserve context.
Expose an 'Advanced details' chevron for long validator messages instead of truncating to ellipses.
Provide three screenshot aspect ratios (16:9, 4:3, 1:1) for Marketing, Docs, and Dashboard gallery.
Microcopy will include fallback generic messages for unknown validator codes to avoid empty states.
Use Lottie for the animated schema generation preview in hero only on supported platforms; fallback to static GIF otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file includes 6-panel storyboard with annotated copy for each panel
Microcopy spreadsheet contains canonical inline, summary, and expanded messages with character counts
Three exported screenshot sets (16:9, 4:3, 1:1) with overlays and captions uploaded to drive
Accessibility check completed and contrast ratios documented
Engineering handoff doc (screenshot checklist + export specs + QA steps) created and linked in PR
Docs snippets added for two common validation flows with example JSON and expected messages
screenshots_needed: Successful validation with green token and summary bar
Warning-level validation with suggested fixes shown
handoff_notes: Include export specs: PNG @2x for hero (1920x1080), PNG @2x for doc inline (1200x900), PNG for thumbnails (600x600)
Engineers should wire validator codes: V001 (missing required), V002 (type mismatch), V003 (schema conflict). Map messages in microcopy spreadsheet.
QA checklist: reproduce 5 validation cases from microcopy file and confirm CTAs trigger editor pane. Add runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SO/Schema+Composer+QA
